table.name: Documents
table.purpose: Stores documents, each based on a template; documents are composed of paragraphs stored in the Paragraphs table.

Document_Name.name: Document_Name
Document_Name.description: Human-readable title of the document (e.g. 'A history of Arts', 'Robbin CV', 'How to read a book').

Template_ID.name: Template_ID
Template_ID.description: Foreign key to Templates.Template_ID, the template the document is based on.

table.name: Paragraphs
table.purpose: Stores the paragraphs (text units) that make up documents; each paragraph belongs to one document.

Document_ID.name: Document_ID
Document_ID.description: Foreign key to Documents.Document_ID, the document this paragraph belongs to.

Paragraph_Text.name: Paragraph_Text
Paragraph_Text.description: Text content of the paragraph. The values are country names (Korea, Brazil, Japan, Somalia...), which is odd for paragraph text; the column is clearly the paragraph's text, but the data appears to be placeholder/sample values.

table.name: Ref_Template_Types
table.purpose: Lookup table of template type codes and their descriptions.

Template_Type_Code.name: Template_Type_Code
Template_Type_Code.description: Primary key; short code for the template type (AD=Advertisement, BK=Book, CV=CV, PP=Paper, PPT=Presentation).

Template_Type_Description.name: Template_Type_Description
Template_Type_Description.description: Human-readable name of the template type (Advertisement, Book, CV, Paper, Presentation).

table.name: Templates
table.purpose: Stores document templates with a type, version number, and effective date range; documents reference a template.

Date_Effective_From.name: Date_Effective_From
Date_Effective_From.description: Start of the template's validity period (timestamp). Note: in some rows it is later than Date_Effective_To, suggesting the data may be unreliable.

Date_Effective_To.name: Date_Effective_To
Date_Effective_To.description: End of the template's validity period (timestamp).

Template_Type_Code.name: Template_Type_Code
Template_Type_Code.description: Foreign key to Ref_Template_Types.Template_Type_Code; the kind of document the template is for (Book, Paper, Presentation, etc.).
